items.passage: Last weekend, we visited an old town in the mountains. The streets were narrow and a little crowded, but the view was wonderful. We stayed in a small, comfortable hotel. The local food was cheap and delicious, and the people were friendly. Next month, we are going to visit a modern city by the sea. It will be a very different but exciting trip.
items.ro1: The city will be very modern.
